with Files("**"):

    "intl",
    "jsaccount",
    "local/public",
    "local/src",
    "mime",
    "news",
    "protocols",
    "search/public",
    "search/src",
]

if CONFIG["MOZ_PANORAMA"]:
    DIRS += ["db/panorama"]

TEST_DIRS += [
    "imap/test",
    "import/test",
    "local/test",
    "search/test",
]

if CONFIG["MOZ_MAPI_SUPPORT"]:
    DIRS += [
        "mapi/mapiDll",
        "mapi/mapihook",
    ]
    TEST_DIRS += ["mapi/test"]

DEFINES["OS_ARCH"] = CONFIG["OS_ARCH"]
DEFINES["MOZ_WIDGET_TOOLKIT"] = CONFIG["MOZ_WIDGET_TOOLKIT"]

JAR_MANIFESTS += ["jar.mn"]
